frame.normalized_box: x and z in [-0.5, 0.5], y in [0, 1]; +Y up, +Z forward; ground at y = 0
frame.attach_pos_normalized: mean over the source parts; pairs are recorded once, on the +X side
frame.symmetry: pair = one entry, mirrored to -X when built; centre = on the midline; radial = repeated around the vertical axis
frame.params.measured: length and root_radius are fractions of the body length; min/max are the observed span widened by 30%
frame.params.shape: variations the research describes; curated, not measured
frame.penetration: how far the root sinks into the core mesh, as a fraction of the root radius

kinds.limb: joint chain grown from the body
kinds.tip: sits on a limb's end joint
kinds.surface: placed on the body or a limb surface
kinds.core: body plan the body itself must form
